Try these steps from the VPN runbook:

1. Confirm your internet works without the VPN (open any public website).
2. Check the date and time on your laptop are correct — a wrong clock breaks the VPN certificate check.
3. Quit the VPN client completely, reopen it, and sign in with your company email.
4. If it still says "authentication failed", your password may have expired — use the "Forgot password" link on the login screen to reset it (code goes to your phone). New passwords need 12 characters and can't repeat your last 5. Update the new password on your phone's mail app too, or it will lock the account again.
5. Try another network, e.g. a phone hotspot. If it works there, your home router is blocking the VPN port.

Note: never share your password here — the helpdesk never asks for it.

If steps 1–5 don't fix it, tell me and I'll open a network ticket for you (medium priority, or high if you can't work at all).

فتحتل并保持 تذكرة: رقم 1 (أولوية عالية) — لأنك ما قادر تشتغل خالص، لازم واحد من الفريق يشوفها.

جربت حسب الدليل: قفل وفتح البرنامج، الساعة مضبوطة، والهوتسبوت — برضو ما اشتغل.

باقي خطوتين من الدليل ما ذكرتهما، ساعدني فيهما:
1. الكمبيوتر يفتح أي موقع عام بدون VPN؟ (يعني النت شغال أصلاً)
2. البرنامج يكتب "authentication failed"؟ إذا نعم، غالباً كلمة السر منتهية — استخدم صفحة "Forgot password" من شاشة الدخول (كود يوصل تلفونك).

ولا ترسل كلمة السر بأي شات أو إيميل.

The mail service is down right now — that's why both Outlook sending and webmail fail. Nothing is wrong on your machine, so no troubleshooting steps will help until the service is back.

What I did:
- Opened ticket #1 (email, high priority) for the team, since this affects everyone.
- Queued a restart request for the mail service. It is pending approval by a human — nothing has been restarted yet.

You don't need to do anything else. I'll leave it with the team; reply here if you still can't send mail after the ticket is picked up.

خطوات إعادة تعيين كلمة السر (من دليل "نسيت كلمة السر"):
1. من شاشة تسجيل الدخول اضغط "Forgot password" — الصفحة الذاتية بتبعت كود على الموبايل المسجّل.
2. لو الحساب مقفول، بيفتح لوحده بعد 15 دقيقة. بلاش تفضل تجرّب، كل محاولة فاشلة بتعيد المؤقّت.
3. كلمة السر الجديدة لازم 12 حرف وتكون مختلفة عن آخر 5 كلمات سر.
4. بعد التغيير، حدّث كلمة السر في تطبيق الإيميل على الموبايل كمان، وإلا هيقفل الحساب تاني.
مهم: الدعم لا يطلب كلمة السر أبداً في الشات أو الإيميل.

خبر مهم: خدمة الإيميل (mail) حالياً متوقفة — الفحص رجّع ConnectionRefusedError. عملت طلب إعادة تشغيل (رقم 1) وهو قيد موافقة إنسان، يعني ما تم إعادة تشغيل أي شيء لحد الآن. وفتحت تذكرة رقم 1 بأولوية high لمتابعة الموضوع.

لو معندكش صلاحية على الموبايل المسجّل، قلي وأحدّث التذكرة.

Since you can't receive the reset code, I can't reset it through the self-service page — the runbook says to escalate when you have no access to the registered phone, so I opened ticket #1 (access, medium priority).

What the runbook notes for when you're back in:
- A locked account unlocks by itself after 15 minutes; don't keep retrying, each failed try restarts the timer.
- New passwords need 12+ characters and must not repeat your last 5.
- After resetting, update the password in your phone mail app too, or the account locks again.

Never share your password in chat or email — the helpdesk won't ask for it. Someone will contact you to verify your identity and get you reset.

Try these steps (from the printer runbook):

1. Check the printer screen for paper jams, empty trays, or low toner, and clear them.
2. Turn the printer off, wait 30 seconds, then turn it on.
3. On your computer, open the print queue, cancel stuck jobs, and print a test page.
4. Make sure you're on the office network, not guest Wi-Fi — guest Wi-Fi can't see printers.

If the printer screen shows a hardware error (fuser, drum, or an error code), reply and I'll open a hardware ticket for you.

خطوات سريعة حسب الدليل:
1. افحص شاشة الطابعة: انزل الورق العالق، وتأكد من الصواني والحبر/التونر.
2. أطفئ الطابعة، انتظر 30 ثانية، ثم شغّلها.
3. على جهازك افتح طابور الطباعة، ألغِ المهام العالقة، واطبع صفحة اختبار.
4. تأكد أنك على شبكة المكتب وليس شبكة الزوار (Guest Wi-Fi لا ترى الطابعات).

إذا كانت رسالة الخطأ على شاشة الطابعة (fuser / drum / رمز خطأ)، فهذا يحتاج تدخل الدعم: فتحت لك تذكرة رقم 1 (أولوية منخفضة، قسم العتاد) ولم يتم إعادة تشغيل أي خدمة.

تم فتح تذكرة بت رقم 1 بأولوية عالية للفريق المختص بالشبكة، لأن المشكلة تخص الطابق كله.

خطوات سريعة من الدليل تنفع مع الأفراد:
1. أعد تشغيل الواي فاي (انسى الشبكة وأعد الاتصال).
2. اقترب من نقطة الوصول، ويفضل كابل الشبكة للمكالمات.
3. تم تسجيل نتيجة اختبار السرعة (2 ميغا) في التذكرة.

المشكلة الآن بيد الفريق المختص، وسيتابعون معك.

This affects everyone, so I've escalated it: ticket #1 is open (critical, VoIP).

What I checked: the PBX service reports up (port open, 0.4 ms), so I did not request a restart.

Please try on one desk phone while you wait:
1. Unplug the network cable for 10 seconds and plug it back — the phone should re-register with the PBX.
2. Test an internal call to another extension. If internal calls work, the problem is the outside line.

If the internal test also fails for everyone, tell the technician on ticket #1 — it needs a person to look at the switch or the phone system.

This is usually a NAT issue with one-way audio over VPN. Try the runbook steps in order:

1. Check your headset is plugged in and selected as the audio device in the softphone settings.
2. Test an internal call to another extension. If internal calls work, the problem is with the outside line.
3. Disconnect the VPN, restart the softphone, then reconnect and test again.
4. If you're on a desk phone too: unplug the network cable for 10 seconds so it re-registers with the PBX.

I checked the PBX service and it's up (port open), so this isn't a system-wide outage. If none of the steps fix it, reply here and I'll open a VoIP ticket for you.

This needs a person, so I opened ticket #1 (critical, server). While you wait, you can check (runbook "Linux server disk full"):

1. Find what's large: `df -h`, then `sudo du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -h | tail -20`
2. Old logs: `sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=7d`, and confirm logrotate runs for app logs
3. If it's a Docker host: `docker system df`, then `docker image prune` — do not run `docker system prune -a` on production without approval
4. Never delete database files or anything under /var/lib/postgresql by hand

Safe steps from our runbook ("Linux server disk full"):

1. Find what's large: `df -h`, then `sudo du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -h | tail -20`.
2. Clear old logs: `sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=7d`, and make sure logrotate is running for application logs.
3. On Docker hosts: run `docker system df`, then `docker image prune`. Do NOT run `docker system prune -a` on production without approval.
4. Never delete database files or anything under /var/lib/postgresql by hand.

Escalate (open a ticket, category server, priority critical) if a service stopped because the disk is full.

Done — I've opened a ticket for Sara Ali's access (email + VPN).

Ticket #1 — priority medium, category access.

Per our runbook, new starter access must be requested by the manager (you), and accounts are created within one working day. To complete the request, please reply with:
1. Full name: Sara Ali (confirmed)
2. Job title
3. Start date (Monday — please confirm the exact date)
4. Team
5. Systems: email + VPN (confirmed)

Access is never granted in chat, so the IT team will provision it from the ticket.

الصلاحيات ما بتتمنح من الشات. حسب الدليل، الطلب لازم يكون من مديرك ومعه: الاسم الكامل، المسمى الوظيفي، تاريخ المباشرة، الفريق، والأنظمة المطلوبة (المجلد المشترك).

فتحت لك تذكرة رقم 1 (أولوية متوسطة) والطلب ناقصها بياناتك واسم مديرك — كلّف مديرك يبعتها ويتفعل الوصول في يوم عمل.

Let's try these steps for a slow laptop:

1. Restart the laptop fully (not sleep/standby) — many slow laptops haven't been restarted in weeks.
2. Open Task Manager, sort by memory, and close browser tabs and apps you aren't using.
3. Check free disk space — under 10% free makes everything slow.
4. Install any pending updates, then restart again.

If it's still slow after these steps, tell me and I'll open a ticket (hardware, low priority) — it may need more memory or a new disk.

The intranet is up — I checked it just now and it's responding normally (HTTP 200, 22 ms), so it's not down.

If it still feels slow, it's likely your laptop. Try these:
1. Restart the laptop properly (not sleep) — many slow machines haven't restarted in weeks.
2. Open Task Manager, sort by memory, and close unused browser tabs and apps.
3. Check free disk space — under 10% free makes everything slow.
4. Install pending updates, then restart again.

If it's still slow after that, tell me and I'll open a ticket (hardware, low priority) — it may need more memory or a new disk.

Mail is confirmed down (connection refused on 127.0.0.1:42811).

I can't restart it myself — I queued a restart request (action 1) that a human must approve, and opened ticket #1 (high priority, email).

While waiting, per the runbook you can check if webmail works in a browser; if it doesn't, the service is down and the fix has to come from the on-call admin approving the restart.

I can't restart the intranet, and nothing has been restarted.

I checked just now: intranet is up (HTTP 200, ~11 ms). A restart request is only valid when the service check shows it down — even then it just queues the request for a human to approve; it never restarts anything by itself.

If something specific is failing (a page, a login, a download), tell me what you see and I'll check the service again and open a ticket for the team.

I can't restart the PBX — I checked it and it's **up** (port open, 0.4 ms latency), so a restart isn't needed (and restarts are queued for a human anyway).

Try these first (from the VoIP runbook):
1. Check your headset is plugged in and selected as the audio device in the softphone settings.
2. Make an internal call to another extension — if internal calls sound fine, the issue is the outside line.
3. If you're on VPN, disconnect it, restart the softphone and test again (one-way/choppy audio over VPN is usually NAT).
4. Desk phone: unplug the network cable for 10 seconds so the phone re-registers.

If calls are broken for everyone, or it's still choppy after these steps, tell me and I'll open a ticket (voip) for a person to look at it.

First, please don't share passwords in chat or email — the helpdesk never needs it, and you should treat that one as exposed and change it.

Common reasons a working password stops working (from the "Forgot password or account locked" runbook):
1. The password expired. New passwords need at least 12 characters and can't repeat your last 5.
2. The account is locked from failed attempts. It unlocks by itself after 15 minutes — don't keep trying, each attempt restarts the timer.
3. The mail app on your phone still has the old password and keeps locking you out.

What to do:
- On the login screen, use "Forgot password" for the self-service reset; it sends a code to your registered phone.
- Wait 15 minutes if you've already tried several times.
- After resetting, update the password in your phone's mail app too.

If you no longer have access to the registered phone, reply and I'll open an access ticket (medium priority) for someone to help verify you.

المشكلة مش بالملف الكبير: خدمة الإيميل نفسها معطّلة (mail = down)، فبتأثّر على كل المستخدمين.

- فتحت تذكرة رقم 1 بأولوية عالية للفريق.
- أرسلت طلب إعادة تشغيل لخدمة الإيميل، هو الآن بانتظار موافقة إنسان — ما تم إعادة تشغيل شي بعد.

بعد ما ترجع الخدمة، حسب الدليل: افتح الصادر واحذف الرسالة العالقة أو صغّر المرفق (أكبر من 25 ميغا) أو ارفع الملف على رابط مشاركة، وتأكد أن "Work Offline" مطفّي في أوتلوك.

The sea keeps no calendar,
only a long grey breathing,
folding the shore in and out
like a page it never finishes.

I checked our runbooks first, as I always do — nothing there covers poetry, so this one is just for you. If anything IT-related comes up, I'm here.

المشكلة في التلفون المكتبي نفسه (الزملاء شغالين، يعني السنترال ما بيهو مشكلة عامة). جرّب الخطوات دي بالترتيب:

1. تأكد إن السماعة (headset) موصولة صح ومختارة كجهاز صوت في إعدادات الـ softphone.
2. اعمل مكالمة داخلية لتحويلة تانية؛ لو المكالمات الداخلية شغالة، المشكلة في الخط الخارجي.
3. لو بتستخدم VPN: افصله، أعمل restart للـ softphone، وجرّب تاني.
4. في تلفون مكتبي: افصل كابل الشبكة 10 ثواني ثم وصّله؛ التلفون بيسجّل نفسه في الـ PBX من جديد.

لو بعد الخطوات دي ما زال ما فيهو صوت، قول لي وأفتح لك تذكرة (voip) لمتابعة الأمر مع الدعم.
